# x-twitter-scraper_x_job (Data Source)

Public X job listings, search and details



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `job` (Attributes) Public X job listing. A search returns the fields down to the salary, plus company & account. A lookup adds work type, seniority, function, team & descriptions. A field X leaves empty is left out. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--job))

<a id="nestedatt--job"></a>
### Nested Schema for `job`

Read-Only:

- `account` (Attributes) The X account that posted a job. A job has none when X imported it from a job board or no longer shows the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--job--account))
- `apply_url` (String) Where applicants apply, off X.
- `company` (Attributes) The company profile of a job X imported from a job board. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--job--company))
- `description` (String) Full description as plain text, 1 line per paragraph.
- `description_markdown` (String) Full description as Markdown, with headings, lists, links, bold & italics.
- `employment_type` (String) Contract type (full_time, full_time_contract, part_time or contract_to_hire).
- `featured` (Boolean) Whether X features the job.
- `formatted_salary` (String) Salary as X shows it.
- `id` (String) Job ID.
- `job_function` (String) Job function, such as software_engineering.
- `location` (String) Location as the employer wrote it.
- `location_type` (String) Where the work happens (onsite, remote or hybrid).
- `posted_at` (String) When the employer posted the job.
- `salary_currency_code` (String) ISO 4217 currency code of the salary.
- `salary_interval` (String) Pay period of the salary (annually or hourly).
- `salary_max` (Number) Highest salary, in salaryCurrencyCode per salaryInterval.
- `salary_min` (Number) Lowest salary, in salaryCurrencyCode per salaryInterval.
- `seniority_level` (String) Seniority (intern, entry_level, junior, mid_level, senior, lead, manager or executive).
- `short_description` (String) Short summary of the job, as plain text.
- `team` (String) Team inside the company.
- `title` (String) Job title.
- `url` (String) The job page on X.

<a id="nestedatt--job--account"></a>
### Nested Schema for `job.account`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Bio of the account. A job lookup returns it.
- `id` (String) X user ID of the account.
- `name` (String) Display name of the account that posted the job.
- `profile_image_shape` (String) Avatar shape, such as Circle or Square.
- `profile_picture` (String) Avatar URL of the account that posted the job.
- `profile_picture_original` (String) The job account's avatar at full size.
- `username` (String) Handle without @.
- `verified` (Boolean) Whether X shows a verification badge on the account.
- `verified_type` (String) Badge type, such as Business or Government.


<a id="nestedatt--job--company"></a>
### Nested Schema for `job.company`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) X company profile ID.
- `logo_url` (String) Company logo URL.
- `name` (String) Company name.
